data.name: Rampage Stain
data.description: Returning from the heights of fury takes a toll on your body. You are staggered for 1 minute after ending a rage of any kind (including berserk fury, barbarian rage, and the rage spell). Nothing can remove this condition, nor does immunity to being staggered prevent it.
